n: 20 Cu. Ft. Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator
desc: This Frigidaire French Door refrigerator offers an internal water dispenser for fresh, filtered water and a clean exterior finish. It's easy to find a place for everything with our large door bins and adjustable shelving.
hl: Internal water dispenser gives you fresh, filtered water while achieving a clean exterior finish in your kitchen.
Our adjustable gallon-size bins are designed to store more, so you can fit a variety of items like condiments and milk.
Keep produce fresher longer, so you waste less and save money.
Always have ice on hand with our built-in ice maker in the freezer.
Prevent warm spots and unwanted freezing with our cooling system that optimizes airflow to ensure a consistent temperature throughout your refrigerator.
Get a clear, bright view of your interior offering you better visibility to reach your family's favorites.
